episodes.title: Haus
episodes.summary: A woman who survived a concentration camp as a girl seeks murderous revenge on Nazis, but those who have been watching her have other plans.

episodes.title: El hotel
episodes.summary: Isabel and Lucena must cozy up to Otto and his wife Ilse as the team works to put their plan in motion ahead of Heim's arrival.

episodes.title: El Gran Club
episodes.summary: Just as Lucena seems to gain Bachmann's trust, the situation takes a challenging and dangerous turn. Marsé opens up to Isabel about his past.

episodes.title: Almería
episodes.summary: The crew travels to Almería in an attempt to track down Otto and Ilse so that they can capture Heim. Castro reveals a personal secret.

episodes.title: El hospital
episodes.summary: With the military closing in, the agents put their lives at risk to get Heim out of the hospital, and one of them makes a stunning confession.

episodes.title: El molino
episodes.summary: While Isabel holds Heim captive, he antagonizes her with stories of torture he inflicted. She reflects on recent memories she made with her new friends.
